name: cache-tax
description: Local fork of cache-tax (karanb192/cache-tax 2.2.1) that adds a Resend and pay button to a refused cold send and makes /keepwarm always a rolling 6h window from the last turn. Publishes each warm ping as state cache-tax.lastPing for cache-meter. Lets peer messages and triggers through the guard priced, and after Claude quits revives sessions whose cache is still warm and reports the rest to Bear. Replaces cache-tax@claude-code-mods; do not enable both.
